verdict.rationale: Factory documents several first-party parallelism mechanisms: multi-agent Missions with worker progress monitoring, isolated per-session worktrees that keep each session separate from other work, droid exec for batch processing, and session management across projects and machines. However, no doc explicitly states that many tasks run concurrently, and nothing shows concurrency limits or throughput at scale. missing for 10: explicit documentation of running many tasks or sessions simultaneously, concurrency limits or scaling guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel throughput.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput

citations.quote: Launch multi-agent Missions with `/missions` or `droid exec --mission`
Monitor active missions, track worker progress, and view detailed execution logs in real time.
The Factory App creates a separate working directory for the session, prepares it, and keeps it isolated from your other work.
making it ideal for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing
Filter and group sessions across projects and machines
